text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation asks for increased local allocation of crude oil, to 300,000 barrels per day from 250,000 bpd.

- Head of oil workers' union NUPENG seeks audience with oil minister to resolve grievances which may lead to strike action. Grievances include payment of salary arrears, better equipment and a stop to indiscriminate redundancies at oil companies.
- About 38 insurance companies yet to pay their statutory deposit at the central bank risk sanctions by the National Insurance Supervisory Board.
- The Nigerian Bag Manufacturing Company recently exported 2.5 million polypropylene sacks worth $500,000 to the United States and Italy.
- Nigerian Beverages Production Co, producers of highland tea, hope to double turnover in 1997 to 120 million naira.
